description: Spotify is a music, podcast, and audiobook streaming service. Its developer platform lets applications access catalog metadata, user library and playback features, and related Spotify data.
summary: Spotify exposes a documented OAuth-protected HTTP Web API at `https://api.spotify.com/v1` with an OpenAPI spec, plus an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://mcp-gateway-external-pilot.spotify.net/mcp` over streamable HTTP.
